# CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE golden vectors (spec D8, §10.1)
# Shared by tests/test_crc.py and tests/lua/run_crc_tests.lua.
# Format: <hex bytes or '-' for empty>  <expected crc16 hex>  # comment
#
# The '123456789' vector is the externally published check value for
# CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (0x29B1) and anchors both implementations.

-  FFFF  # empty input -> init value
00  E1F0  # single zero byte
ff  FF00  # single 0xFF
313233343536373839  29B1  # standard check string '123456789' (published: 0x29B1)
00000000000000000000  E139  # ten zero bytes
  3FBD  # 0x00..0xFF ramp
a55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55aa55a  77E8  # alternating A5 5A x64
03000200c0ff0000d007000000000100d00700000300881300000000000000000000640000000400  8B85  # realistic step-table payload (header+3 steps+2 abort)
